title: Issues with updating goals
body:
I created several goals and noticed there’s issues with updating the symbols. Once changed in the edit section, it instantly changes back to the original symbol (glitch). 

Also, goals sometimes come to an end. Can you please add an ‘end date’ option? For example, I’m starting a goal practice driving weekly, and to take my G test. Once I get my licence, this goal will be completed. I noticed there’s no way to end that goal, it just continues to get repeated into the next month. I understand there’s a delete goal option, however, I would like to see my progress when I look back instead of deleting all of my success.

title: Minimal no fuss and pretty
body:
Honestly this feels like an old school piece of software in the modern day. No subs, no payments, no popups, no annoying notifs. 

Just a solid app that does exactly what it says it does, its smooth and it looks good at the same time.

Thank you for making this app! 

Also recommend updating your website link in the settings because it leads to an inactive domain, and it would be nice to donate to the dev since it’s a free app.
